Choosing your hangar: Microsoft agent platforms

takeaways: Automation executes fixed rules with speed and consistency, while a real agent observes, plans and acts in a feedback loop with memory and some autonomy.
A working agent needs perception, memory, reasoning, learning and action, plus governance with secure data intake, audit trails and human oversight for high-stakes decisions.

Pick the platform by user type, complexity, data sensitivity and integration needs, from SharePoint agents and Copilot Studio to Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel and AutoGen, and use plain automation when the process is well defined.
hook: Many so-called AI agents are just scripts with a new label, and that confusion breaks trust and governance. This episode is for IT leaders and makers deciding between automation and agents in the Microsoft ecosystem. Learn the observe-plan-act loop, the five core components of an agent, the governance controls you need and how to choose the right platform.
